items.description: Bookafy is an online scheduling and appointment tracking web app. This mashup makes use of the Zendesk Core API for ticket tracking and management.
The Nearby Tweets project extends Twitter into a geography–centric social tool for networking and a business tool for building customer relationships and monitoring real–time buzz.
DocuSign is an online electronic signature service. It is integrated with Box.net, so users can send files to be e-signed with DocuSign from within the Box.net environment.
BedMap is an interactive hotel map with detailed pricing comparisons and help options. Search more than 90,000 available hotels and book a room instantly.
Search and find YouTube videos, watch a video, and share it with friends.
A simon game for telephone using DTMF tones.
